normalization.method: one uniform scale per raw generated source master, derived from the geometric mean of canonical-to-source median orange head-and-ear width and centered blue torso/bib width; crop transparent cell padding; translate each cell's torso anchor to x=256 and lowest supporting alpha to y=465; preserve each canonical input cell pixel-for-pixel

landmark_measurement.head: orange fur pixels above 42% of each significant-alpha bbox height; measured width includes head and ears
landmark_measurement.torso: blue overall/bib pixels in the centered 48% of the significant-alpha bbox width and the 30%-52% height band
